description: Payment charge requests fail and surface as checkout failures.

incident.title: Checkout requests are failing
incident.description: Customers cannot complete checkout; investigate the downstream cause.

diagnostic_reference.observable_mechanism: Payment Charge executes and rejects with the observed Invalid token application error. The message alone does not establish a real credential configuration defect.
diagnostic_reference.propagation: The linked checkout charge call fails and prevents order completion.
exclusions: Do not claim caller-side resolution failure instead of the observed handler rejection.
Do not infer financial settlement or safe retries.
